description: List every season of an FRC district by abbreviation, following renames (e.g., 'mar' to 'fma'). Returns one district record per year (key, abbreviation, display name, year) with the official number of teams that advance to the district championship and to the FIRST Championship. Use to find a district's key for a past season or to see how its advancement slots changed over time.

district_abbreviation.description: FRC district abbreviation without a year (e.g., 'fim' for FIRST in Michigan, 'ne' for New England, 'chs' for Chesapeake, 'pnw' for Pacific Northwest, 'fit' for FIRST In Texas). Covers every season of the district, including renames such as 'mar' to 'fma'. Use get_districts to discover abbreviations.
